cryptography.scope: Missing crypto/subtle/digest blocks storage initialization and both Wi-Fi roles. Large optical receiver rejects missing SubtleCrypto before camera access. Explicit memory and codec-only fallback are distinct from full application support.

telemetry.elapsedScope: Current attempt, from progress initialization through verification/failure; includes pauses, excludes preparation, prior attempts and saving.
telemetry.browserEvidence: Paused attempt clock advances, sender speeds/ETA clear, byte totals persist, verified clocks freeze, new-transfer view clears, journal/crash/reload resume counts match durable receipts.
telemetry.visualReview: Desktop and 390px layouts reviewed with no clipping or horizontal overflow in new metrics. Full-page sender remains long; visibility and task completion with nontechnical users are not established.
